title.en: Look at a CDN's cache headers

why.en: A HEAD request shows Cache-Control, Age and often an X-Cache style header without downloading the body.
why.hinglish: HEAD request body download kiye bina Cache-Control, Age aur aksar X-Cache jaisa header dikha deti hai.

expect.en: Response headers such as cache-control, age and cf-cache-status (HIT, MISS or DYNAMIC). Names and values vary by CDN and by time.
expect.hinglish: cache-control, age aur cf-cache-status (HIT, MISS ya DYNAMIC) jaise response headers. Naam aur values CDN aur waqt ke hisaab se badalte hain.

title.en: See the CDN name behind a site
title.hinglish: Site ke peeche CDN ka naam dekho

why.en: Sites using a CDN usually have a CNAME pointing at the CDN's domain.
why.hinglish: CDN use karne wali sites ka aksar CNAME CDN ke domain ki taraf point karta hai.

expect.en: One or more anycast IP addresses, possibly after a CNAME. The addresses differ depending on where you are.
expect.hinglish: Ek ya zyada anycast IP addresses, shayad CNAME ke baad. Addresses is par depend karte hain ki tum kahan ho.

title.en: Find cache HIT and MISS in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein cache HIT aur MISS dhoondo

why.en: The lesson capture uses plain HTTP so the caching headers are visible.
why.hinglish: Lesson capture plain HTTP use karta hai taaki caching headers dikhein.

expect.en: Responses with Cache-Control, Age and X-Cache lines; the first shows MISS with Age 0 and the later one HIT with Age 1800.
expect.hinglish: Cache-Control, Age aur X-Cache lines wale responses; pehla Age 0 ke saath MISS dikhata hai aur baad wala Age 1800 ke saath HIT.
